% =============================================================
% dissertation.tex
% Master document for Diego Polanco's PhD dissertation.
%
% ARCHITECTURE:
%   - Frozen chapters in Chapter1/, Chapter2/, Chapter3/
%   - Integration wrappers in integration/
%   - Shared configuration in config/
%   - Working front matter in frontmatter/
%   - Build artifacts go to build/ (via latexmkrc)
%
% BUILD:
%   latexmk -pdf dissertation.tex
%
% IMMUTABILITY:
%   Chapter1/, Chapter2/, Chapter3/ are frozen source directories.
%   Do not edit files inside them during shell/integration work.
% =============================================================

\documentclass[11pt,oneside]{book}

% ---- Load shared configuration ------------------------------
\input{config/packages}
\input{config/macros}
\input{config/style}
\input{config/chapter-adapters}

% =============================================================
% BEGIN DOCUMENT
% =============================================================
\begin{document}

% ---- FRONT MATTER -------------------------------------------
\frontmatter
\pagenumbering{roman}

% Advisor-review title page; institutional approval pages remain deferred.
\input{frontmatter/working-title}

\input{frontmatter/abstract}

% ============================================================
% FUTURE FRONT MATTER
% Dedication
% Acknowledgments
% Institutional pages (committee, copyright, approval/signatures)
% ============================================================

% ---- Table of Contents --------------------------------------
\clearpage
{\setlength{\parskip}{1pt}
\tableofcontents}

% ---- List of Figures ----------------------------------------
\clearpage
\listoffigures

% ---- List of Tables -----------------------------------------
\clearpage
\begingroup
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\@pnumwidth}{2.5em}
\renewcommand{\@tocrmarg}{3.5em}
\makeatother
\listoftables
\endgroup

% ---- MAIN MATTER -------------------------------------------
\mainmatter
\pagenumbering{arabic}

% ---- Dissertation Introduction -----------------------------
\include{frontmatter/introduction}

% ---- Essay 1 -----------------------------------------------
\include{integration/chapter1}

% ---- Essay 2 -----------------------------------------------
\include{integration/chapter2}

% ---- Essay 3 -----------------------------------------------
\include{integration/chapter3}

% ---- Consolidated dissertation synthesis --------------------
\include{backmatter/conclusion}

\end{document}
